themes.label: AI curing patients, improving well-being
themes.definition: AI cited as an example of technology improving health and well-being, with hope that its benefits reach all people.
themes.inclusion: Include passages crediting AI with health or well-being improvements.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages where AI is only listed among technologies.
themes.boundary_cases: An appeal that benefits reach 'all people, not only some' could also be coded AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: In the past few minutes, a patient has been cured thanks to artificial intelligence.

themes.label: Technology benefits for all, not some
themes.definition: Hope that technological progress, including AI, benefits all people rather than a few.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI/technology benefits should reach everyone.
themes.exclusion: Exclude statements about concentration of control by states or companies (AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION).
themes.boundary_cases: Adjacent references to platform workers' conditions are labour issues, not AI divide.

examples.quote: I hope that technology continues progressing to improve the lives and well-being of all people — not only of some but of all people.

value.rationale: Spain's rhetorical passage uses AI curing a patient as an illustration of technology's promise and hopes its benefits reach all people; the adjacent gig-worker remark is not tied to AI.
